description: Create a new page inside a Doc (ClickUp Docs v3), optionally nested under an existing page and with initial content. Returns the created page with its id.

content.description: Initial page body content. Format is set by `content_format`.

doc_id.description: ID of the Doc to add the page to.

parent_page_id.description: ID of an existing page to nest this new page under.

sub_title.description: Optional subtitle shown under the page title.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: create_doc_page
